name: Khushboo Behede (Jade C181)
player_statement:
A complete player, Khushboo Behede (Jade C181) has made a big mark in cricket. With 7 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 17*, with an average of 11.75 and a quick strike rate of 97.92. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 4 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 15.0 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 4.80. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
